import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans

# Constants for configuration
RANGE = 100
SIZE = 1000
CLUSTERS = 5

def task_func():
    data = np.random.uniform(0, RANGE, size=(SIZE, 2))

    kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=CLUSTERS, random_state=42, n_init=10)
    labels = kmeans.fit_predict(data)
    centroids = kmeans.cluster_centers_

    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
    plt.scatter(data[:, 0], data[:, 1], c=labels, cmap="viridis", s=20, alpha=0.7)
    plt.scatter(
        centroids[:, 0],
        centroids[:, 1],
        c="red",
        marker="X",
        s=200,
        edgecolors="black",
        linewidths=1,
        label="Centroids",
    )
    plt.title("KMeans Clustering of Random 2D Points")
    plt.xlabel("X")
    plt.ylabel("Y")
    plt.xlim(0, RANGE)
    plt.ylim(0, RANGE)
    plt.legend()
    plt.tight_layout()

    return data, kmeans
